about: Fresh XXL Nail Diaries ideas, three added every week. Newest week last. s = series (can, qa, sets, dumps); t = title; h = hook; sh = shot list or slides; c = caption; tg = 5 hashtags; cta = call to action; f = format.

ideas.t: Can I peel a clementine with XXL nails?
ideas.h: Clementine season vs. my XXL nails. Somebody's losing.
sh: A clementine on a clean counter, gold rings on, nails tapping the peel. Ask: "Can I do it?"
The attempt: one real-time close-up, going for a single long spiral of peel.
Verdict + hand a slice to the camera — Easy / Takes Practice / Not Happening.
ideas.cta: What should I peel next? Pomegranate is NOT an option 👇

ideas.t: Do you ever accidentally scratch people?
ideas.h: The question I get every single time I go in for a hug.
sh: Skit: go in for a hug with a friend, hands hovering dramatically, palms only.
Close-up: the knuckle-scratch and pads-only tuck-your-hair technique.
Talk to camera: the house rules (pads only, nails pointed out, hugs given with care).
ideas.c: Hugs are given with ✨care✨ Pads only, nails pointed out 💅
ideas.cta: Tag the friend who's scared to hug me 😂

ideas.h: Holiday season but make it XXL.
sh: Curling gift ribbon with a nail
Final: both hands framing a wrapped gift
ideas.c: Caption prompt: rate your holiday energy in one line + the set name. e.g. "Holiday mode: activated. Nails: XXL. 🎄💅"
